app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Avaliação
body: Considero a aplicação muito útil. Sou uma crítica no que concerne estas aplicações pois já tive várias. Daria 5 estrelas se o premium não fosse tão caro, por esse motivo não irei comprar o premium.
author: nesssssss28

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Simplicity + Functionality = Best App
body: Very easy to use and set up. Has different measurements for tracking your goals (time; days; start and end date; etc) which is perfect for me. You open it and everything is there right in front of you in an intuitive and comprehensive display so you can see how many of your goals you have achieved and what's left for you to achieve them
author: unicorn-pig
